title: AssetsLedger
description: Every asset downloaded into the data directory (fonts, HDRIs, model weights) with its source, license, hashes and files. Written as assets.json under the data directory by src/net/asset-ledger.ts; commands consult it before downloading again and credits are generated from it.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

assets.description: The downloaded assets, sorted by id; empty when nothing has been downloaded.

AssetRecord.description: One downloaded asset and where it came from.

id.description: Stable identifier chosen by the command that downloaded the asset, unique within the ledger, for example "font:inter" or "hdri:studio_small_09".

source.description: The URL the download started from, for example https://dl.polyhaven.com/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/studio_small_09_1k.hdr.

finalUrl.description: The URL that served the bytes after redirects, for example https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/studio_small_09_1k.hdr.

license.description: SPDX identifier or license name, for example "CC0-1.0" or "OFL-1.1".

bytes.description: Size of the downloaded file in bytes, for example 1615248.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded file as 64 lowercase hex characters, verified against the pin.

md5.description: MD5 of the downloaded file as 32 lowercase hex characters; present when the source publishes one.

fetchedAt.description: When the download finished: an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-26T12:01:00.000Z.

credit.description: Attribution text the source asks for, for example "HDRI by Poly Haven (CC0)"; present when there is one.

files.description: Paths, relative to the data directory with forward slashes, that belong to this asset; at least the downloaded file.
